messages:
emily: Quick prelaunch SEO sync — we need link surgery, structured snippets, UTM swaps for launch posts and webinar funnel. Growth + infra: can you help with redirects & UTM mapping? No 302s leaking equity, canonical consistency, JSON-LD for webinar pages.

javier: I can own the UTM mapping + GA. I'll put together a CSV with utm_source/medium/campaign. Target EOD. Which URLs are top priority?

emily: Priorities: /blog/launch-post, /webinar/register, /benchmarks/2026-report, plus the new case-study landing (path will change after CMS publish). Canonical for republished blog should be /blog/launch-post. Also kill /tag/old-launch tag pages that dilute signals.

noah: Redirect plan: permanent moves -> 301. Temporary A/B swaps -> 302 but annotate in sheet. Example nginx for 301:

```nginx
location = /old-launch {
  return 301 https://www.redwood.inference/blog/launch-post;
}
```

megan: Structured data: I'll add JSON-LD Event schema on /webinar/register and the webinar LP. Use @type: Event, include startDate, location: "Online", performer: speaker names, sameAs: speaker URLs. Add mainEntityOfPage pointing to canonical.

javier: Uploaded draft CSV: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcXYZdUMOCKUP (sheet: utm-map). Columns: old_path,new_path,redirect_type,canonical_target,utm_campaign. Please review and flag contradictions.

emily: @noah can you schedule a redirect sweep after CSV review? Tag @content for final JSON-LD copy check. Aim to deploy tomorrow 10:00am PT if infra is clear. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: redirect-sweep queued for 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z. Will post status in #deploy-notifications.

megan: I'll add a sample JSON-LD block in the sheet and open a tiny PR to content repo for review.

javier: QA plan: verify redirects return 301s, destinations 200, canonical headers/meta correct, run Lighthouse on the three priority pages post-change. I'll mark checks in the CSV.

content: Review PR 412: checked copy; microcopy tweaks suggested for webinar CTA and schema description. Approving after tweaks.

emily: Nice. Quick run-down checklist: 1) javier finalize CSV and QA checks; 2) megan JSON-LD PR merged; 3) noah deploy window + nginx rules; 4) content final copy. Ping here when all green.
